name: Formula Block
when_to_pick: Display a single key formula — Kelly fraction, expected value, Sharpe ratio, position size, R-multiple, pip value — as a standout reference block. Use when one equation is the centerpiece and deserves large monospace typography, an accent rail, and a 'where' note defining its variables. For a runnable code snippet use code_block instead; for multiple stacked equations use one formula_block per equation.

label.description: Short name of the formula, shown as an uppercase label chip above the equation (e.g. 'Kelly criterion — optimal position size').

body.description: The formula itself, as trusted inline HTML (rendered with |safe). Wrap each variable name in X so it gets the accent italic styling; / for exponents/indices and ( for muted grouping operators are supported. HTML entities like − × ÷ ≈ · render the proper math glyphs.

note.description: Optional explanatory note, shown after a 'where' marker, defining each variable and (ideally) a one-line worked example. Trusted inline HTML allowed: <var>, <strong>, <sup>/<sub>, and math entities. Keep it tight — definitions plus one numeric example.
